items.title: IBM (IBM) Secures FedRAMP Moderate Authorization For Maximo Government SaaS
items.summary: International Business Machines (NYSE: IBM) reported that its Maximo Application Suite for Government has achieved FedRAMP Moderate Authorization as a Software as a Service offering. The authorization allows IBM to provide Maximo as a secure, compliant SaaS option for U.S. federal agencies and other organizations that require federally validated security controls.
